capabilities: enable justified text in preview mode
set per-file hyphenation language via frontmatter
apply CSS rules to paragraph and list elements while excluding external links
extras: The README is brief and notes the author's personal styling choice (external links are excluded because the author finds them ugly when hyphenated); no screenshots or troubleshooting are given.
problem: Obsidian does not offer justified text or automatic hyphenation, so long words leave uneven gaps in justified paragraphs.
summary: Hyphenation plugin that enables justified text and hyphenation in notes, using the browser language or a per-file lang frontmatter key.
